messages:
Lars: Morning — espresso machine spit out an error code "E04" and there's no decaf left. Anyone going to the co-op for lunch?
Noor: I can do a quick run at 12:20. What do we need?
Gia: Please get: decaf pods (box), oat milk, small jar almond butter (avoid peanut), and some veggie sushi? Also we ran out of napkins.
Tom: Heads up: company policy says avoid sushi after 6pm in fridge. If it's for lunch today that's fine.
Lars: Good call. Sushi for immediate consumption only. Also add a pack of compostable napkins.
Noor: Using company card. Quick Q: is almond butter okay or do we need fully nut-free? We have someone with a mild peanut allergy.
Gia: Almond is fine — just label it.
inventory-bot: inventory-bot: Snapshot: decaf_pods=0, oat_milk=1, peanut_butter=0, almond_butter=0, napkins=2, espresso_status=E04. Auto-order=false. Run `/kitchen order` to trigger vendor order.
Noor: I'll pick almond butter then. ETA 12:45. I'll take photo of receipt and drop in #finance. Tag as REDWOOD-KITCHEN-RECEIPT.
Tom: Can someone check the cupboard for clean spoons? We keep running out. Maybe add disposable teaspoon pack.
Gia: Also please label the new almond jar. People forget. I can bring masking tape + marker.
Lars: Also put a tiny laminated note on the machine: "If E04 occurs, unplug for 30s and ping eng-facilities". Saves a call to facilities.
Noor: Back at 12:48. Bought decaf, oat milk x2, almond butter, sushi for 4, napkins, disposable spoons. Receipt uploaded to #finance. Left a sticky with items added.
inventory-bot: inventory-bot: Updated inventory: decaf_pods=1, oat_milk=3, almond_butter=1, napkins=6, disposable_spoons=1. Espresso status still E04 (needs facilities).
Tom: Thanks Noor! I left a note on eng-facilities and CC'd @ops.
Gia: Quick survey — do we want a communal tip jar for food runs or keep using company card? Option A: company card + receipts. Option B: volunteers front it and get reimbursed.
Lars: Company card makes life easier for ad-hoc runs.
Noor: Agreed. Less Venmo juggling.
Gia: OK moving forward company card for shared items. Volunteers can add small personal items separately.
Tom: Can we also agree on 'label and keep for 72h' rule? I found mystery bento in there for 5 days.
Lars: 72h rule, masking tape + marker on shelf, and a small whiteboard to note "last clean".
inventory-bot: inventory-bot: Reminder set: post a "kitchen norms" draft tomorrow at 9am. Use `/kitchen norms` to edit.
Noor: Putting up a printed note now. Thanks team! :coffee::sushi:
